text: The hazard ratio confidence intervals should be presented alongside the point estimate in the primary efficacy table. Current text cites HR 0.61 without 95% CI bounds.
Per ICH E3 §9.4.1, the primary endpoint analysis must include the pre-specified sensitivity analysis results. Please add the per-protocol population analysis.
Screen failure reasons should be presented as a table per Section 16.2.1 checklist requirement.
Pneumonitis incidence rate (4.2%) should be cross-referenced with the MedDRA PT code 10035742 and compared to the pembrolizumab monotherapy arm rate from the reference dataset.
